title: Grateful Dead Live at Providence Civic Center on 1982-04-15
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave > R8Brain > TLH > FLAC 1644 Tagged.
source: 3x Nakamichi CM300/CP1's > Nakamichi 550 > Maxell XLII-S. Mics on stand, FOB floor, right center.

ai_review.summary: High‑quality mp3 with less crowd noise captures a fan‑favorite show, highlighted by strong performances despite a minor lyric slip.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its depth and reduced audience bleed, making it sound cleaner than other available versions. Reviewers love the show overall, calling it one of their favorites even though Brent’s keyboard/vocal slip at the end of a song is noted. Overall it’s a solid listening experience with strong musical energy.

ai_rating.rationale: Single five‑star review emphasizes both an excellent performance and good audio quality, but limited data reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Less crowd noise and more depth than other uploads; mp3 version noted as clearer. No major technical flaws reported.

band_member_comments.Keys: Brent messes up the lyrics a little at the end of the song.
